# Band NYX (bandnyx)

> Official press kit and booking information for Band NYX live band.

## Canonical facts

- **Band name:** Band NYX (also written bandnyx)
- **Official website:** https://vishanthlynn.github.io/bandNyx/

- **Founder Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/lynnvishanth/ (@lynnvishanth)

- **Established:** 2026
- **Genre / style:** Rock, melody, energy — six-piece live band (India and USA)

## Common questions

**Who founded Band NYX?**  
Vishanth founded and manages Band NYX. Contact: https://www.instagram.com/lynnvishanth/

**Who runs / manages the band?**  
Vishanth is the founder and manager.

**How do I book Band NYX?**  
Use the phones above or Instagram @band.nyx. See the website contact section.
